_note: Routing corpus of record for skills-refactor — LIBRARY-LEVEL restructuring of an EXISTING skill: rename / merge / retire / split, rewiring every live cross-reference (peer_skills, routing pointers, rubric-load paths, gate-script keys, catalog rows, routing baselines) while preserving dated history and re-running the gate suite. Positives span the invocation families (imperative rename/merge/retire/split, object-first 'these two skills', symptom 'dangling references after rename', indirect-paraphrase). Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from NAMED siblings: skills-studio (AUTHOR a new skill / EDIT one skill's content / OPTIMIZE its description / SCORE / CRITIQUE / EVAL — quality work on ONE skill, not a structural move across the library), meta-app-scaffold (scaffold an apps/{name}/ FOUNDATION), plugin-decomposer (a PLUGIN bundle/manifest), meta-expert-author (author a [domain]-expert KNOWLEDGE skill), ops-repo (project-repo doc/AGENTS.md audits). Each negative belongs to one named sibling, in its vocabulary. routing-eval measures LEXICAL overlap only — paraphrase positives may miss; a proxy limit, not a defect.
